main_text.l: essentialiter, sed ex absoluto suo beneplacito,
sicuti dixi de misericordia & iustitia Dei,
quatenus ad creaturas referuntur. In hoc enim
elucet Dei sanctitas, quod ferio amet &
approbet, quæ creaturis rationalibus impe-
rat, & si Deus tum angelis tum hominibus
imperasset longe diversa, imo oppositia
hisce quæ jam de facto imperat, non minus sanctus
fuisset Iehovah, quam nunc est: jubet Christus
simus misericordes & inimicorum propensi
amatores, sicut est pater cœlestis. At
vero pater cœlestis & æque misericors & æque
perfectus fuisset, atque nunc est, si inimicis suis
nec solis, nec pluviarum copiam fecisset,
nec ullo modo ipsorum misertus fuisset, quippe
miseretur, quorum vult.

page.notes: Bottom left of the page holds a stray mark, not printed text, and was left out. The word "eate-" at the foot is a line-end hyphen, and the word continues on the next page. Refp. (Resp.) is printed as "Refp.". Some abbreviations, e.g. "praelect." in the margin note, were read from a small scan and may be imperfect. The reading "Christus simus" in the first paragraph is doubtful and was not marked with [?].
